scope: Three approved still-image examples, not a controlled style comparison or video validation.

examples.title: 自然日常
examples.use: Style benchmark; use as identity anchor only if this exact person is selected.
examples.review_notes: 短而较宽的轮廓、单眼皮、较宽鼻部与嘴部可见，妆感克制、微露上牙；下颌转折比设计更柔和。

examples.title: 日韩轻修图
examples.use: Style benchmark; use as identity anchor only if this exact person is selected.
examples.review_notes: 轮廓收束、鼻部较小，肤质与妆容比自然款精致，唇釉与轻腮红可见；不把修图差异当作骨相差异。

examples.title: 复古
examples.use: Style benchmark; use as identity anchor only if this exact person is selected.
examples.review_notes: 脸部更长、鼻梁与颧部层次更明确，波浪发、红唇与暖调形成复古方向；眼睑褶皱比预定内双更明显，唇面比柔雾目标略润。
